claims.claim: Independent direct access to the nine frozen Temu searches produced page shells without verifiable product records, while all nine AliExpress searches redirected to a login synchronization page.

No assigned SKU has a directly verified Temu or AliExpress offer establishing exact/OEM/comparable classification together with seller, current inventory, US warehouse and ordinary public ZIP10001 delivered price.
Secondary indexes show current or recent AliExpress model-family candidates for P20 Max, WU130X and GO 3S, but these cannot establish the frozen exact variants or transactional fields.
AliExpress-linked item 1005010313425811 is indexed as DJI ROMO-compatible replacement brushes, filters, mop pads and dust bags rather than a ROMO P robot.
Manufacturer or series documentation supports keeping the frozen P20 Max, ROMO P, WU130X.1, Sony and GO 3S variant boundaries separate; these sources do not establish marketplace coverage.
The audit retains all 27 original job-SKU observations: 18 verified-head-stratum rows and 9 provisional/non-head rows.

W4-B contains non-URL Markdown strings in some url fields, and W4-C mis-types some direct marketplace-access sources as secondary; these are structural corrections independent of marketplace availability.

data_gaps: No Temu product-detail page for any frozen SKU was readable enough to verify whole-product exact/OEM/comparable/reseller status.
AliExpress direct searches require a login synchronization step in this independent pass; candidate item pages were blocked or login-required.
No verified marketplace seller identity, current inventory, US-warehouse evidence, region/variant fulfillment eligibility, or ZIP10001 ordinary public delivered total exists for any frozen SKU.
No secondary-index price was promoted to an exact price comparison or landed-savings calculation.
OEM identity cannot be inferred from image/spec similarity and remains unverified for all nine SKUs.
Temu page shells cannot distinguish true zero search results from dynamic-rendering, geo, session or anti-bot limitations.
The original three W4 reports remain usable only as provisional access-limited observations, not as evidence of VERIFIED_UNAVAILABLE.
